notes.title: Fixing One Drop Bot
notes.notes:
First I just want to thank everyone who was patient with this game and its flaws. And for those who weren't happy with it for either the camera or the resolution issues, I'd invite you to give the game a second chance after this update. The update will drop at midnight tonight(EST). 

I believe I have smashed every major bug, but I cannot say that with absolute certainty. If you do find more bugs or any other issues, don't hesitate to mention it in the pinned bugs and issues discussion, and I will handle it in a subsequent update.

I have also added leader boards. They may need some tweaking, but they should work after the update.

Change Log:
-Camera fixed for Mouse
-Camera control limited to horizontal axis
-Camera control limited to open rooms
-Generally tightened up camera controls
-Resolution and Full Screen settings fixed
-Slight change to how player interacts with ledges
-Player speed slightly decreased
-Some issues with controller and menus resolved
-Adjustments to how pushing works
-issues with menus and controllers resolved
-issue with triangle room disappearing while still in it resolved
